# Catching Chrome Guide Service

> Oregon fishing guide service run by Captain Ryan, a USCG-licensed captain with 40+ years of fishing experience (first aid and CPR certified). Guided salmon, steelhead, sturgeon and American shad trips on the Columbia River and Oregon coastal rivers, plus Dungeness crab off the Oregon coast. All rods, reels, tackle, bait and safety gear are provided, and the catch is cleaned and bagged. Based in Gladstone, Oregon. Phone (503) 936-9090. Full day $250, half day $150 per person.

## Trips
- [Winter steelhead](https://www.catchingchromeguideservice.com/winter-steelhead): Oregon coastal tributaries, December to April, light tackle or fly rod
- [Spring Chinook](https://www.catchingchromeguideservice.com/spring-chinook): springers on the Willamette, Clackamas, Sandy, McKenzie and Rogue, mid March to mid June
- [Fall Chinook](https://www.catchingchromeguideservice.com/fall-chinook): kings on the Columbia and coastal rivers, August to October
- [Sturgeon](https://www.catchingchromeguideservice.com/sturgeon): Columbia River sturgeon, May through July
- [American shad](https://www.catchingchromeguideservice.com/american-shad): Columbia River shad, mid May to mid June, great for kids
- [Dungeness crab](https://www.catchingchromeguideservice.com/dungeness-crab): crabbing off the Oregon coast, from $150 per person
- [All excursions](https://www.catchingchromeguideservice.com/excursions)
- [Pricing](https://www.catchingchromeguideservice.com/pricing)
